_format: entries newest first; every entry has a version. status "dev" = in development (at most one, first); no status = released. date: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" locally, published as "YYYY-MM-DD". item type: new | improve | fix. zh/en text; `backticks` become <code>.

items.zh: 修复部分加密 `.ysm` 模型（如芙兰朵露）导入失败、报“Buffer overflow while reading string”：格式版本 18 的模型包现在按它实际使用的旧版结构解析，模型、动画、贴图、音效和作者头像都能正常读出。
items.en: Fixed some encrypted `.ysm` models (such as 芙兰朵露) failing to import with "Buffer overflow while reading string": packs with format version 18 are now read using the older layout they actually use, so models, animations, textures, sounds and author avatars all load.

items.zh: 动作轮盘左上角新增拖动手柄（鼠标悬停在轮盘上时显示），可把轮盘拖到 3D 视图中的任意位置，双击回到中间；可在 设置 → 外观 →“轮盘拖动手柄”中关闭。
items.en: The action wheel has a drag handle at its top left (shown while the pointer is over the wheel): drag it to move the wheel anywhere in the 3D view, double-click to centre it. Turn it off in Settings → Appearance → Wheel drag handle.

items.zh: 动作轮盘中心新增锁定按钮（与游戏一致，快捷键 Alt+L）：锁定后在操控模式中走、跑、跳、潜行和飞行不会打断正在播放的轮盘动作。
items.en: New lock button in the centre of the action wheel (as in the game, shortcut Alt+L): while locked, walking, running, jumping, sneaking and flying in play mode no longer interrupt the wheel action.

items.zh: 修复依赖帧间隔的模型动画不动：新增 `ysm.time_delta` 和 `q.delta_time`（与游戏一致，为上一帧到这一帧的秒数）。双马尾粉猫猫的“触手小黄油”小游戏里障碍物现在会移动。
items.en: Fixed model animations that rely on the frame interval standing still: added `ysm.time_delta` and `q.delta_time` (seconds since the previous frame, as in the game). The obstacles in 双马尾粉猫猫's 触手小黄油 minigame now move.

items.zh: 界面文字不再能被鼠标选中，拖动视图、双击、拖滑条时不会误选文字；输入框仍可正常选中和复制。
items.en: Interface text can no longer be selected with the mouse, so dragging the view, double-clicking or dragging sliders no longer highlights text by accident; text fields can still be selected and copied.

items.zh: 修复动画脚本中 `条件 ? { … }` 代码块从不执行的问题，并支持模型函数（`functions/*.molang`，`fn.名称(…)`）。双马尾粉猫猫“触手小黄油”等动画的声音现在会播放，其他使用条件代码块的模型（如飘带物理）也与游戏一致。
items.en: Fixed `condition ? { … }` blocks in animation scripts never running, and added model functions (`functions/*.molang`, `fn.name(…)`). Sounds in animations such as 双马尾粉猫猫's 触手小黄油 now play, and other models that use conditional blocks (for example ribbon physics) now behave as in the game.

items.zh: 支持模型的 Molang 事件函数（`functions/名称@事件.molang`），按游戏的时机执行：`player_init`（模型载入时一次）、`player_update`（每帧动画前）、`<前缀>_ctrl_<槽位>`（创建并驱动对应控制器）、`ysm.sync` 与 `ysm.defer` 触发的 `sync` / `defer`。同时修复模型函数文件中的 `//` 和 `/* */` 注释导致整个函数不执行的问题。标枪等模型的飞行物跟随计算现在会运行。
items.en: Added model Molang event functions (`functions/name@event.molang`), run at the same moments as in the game: `player_init` (once when the model loads), `player_update` (every frame before the animations), `<prefix>_ctrl_<slot>` (creates and drives that controller), and `sync` / `defer` triggered by `ysm.sync` and `ysm.defer`. Also fixed `//` and `/* */` comments in function files stopping the whole function from running. The flying-companion follow logic of models such as 标枪 now runs.

items.zh: 动作轮盘、模型名、简介和作者信息跟随界面语言：模型自带语言文件（`lang/en_us.json` 等）时，轮盘扇区名称、子分类路径、设置面板的标题、说明和选项，以及详情页、封面和模型库中的模型名、简介、作者都显示为界面所选语言；与游戏相同，模型没有该语言时使用英文，连英文也没有时显示模型原文。
items.en: The action wheel, model name, description and authors follow the interface language: when a model ships language files (`lang/en_us.json` etc.), wheel sector names, the sub-wheel path, settings panel titles, descriptions and options, and the model name, description and authors on the Details page, the cover and in the model library are shown in the selected interface language; as in the game, a model without that language uses English, and the model’s own text when it has no English either.

items.zh: 修复部分模型（如粉白蛔虫娘）所有动作都不动、轮盘点“挥手”等没有动画：现在能播放 `{"vector": [...]}` 写法的关键帧，并在导入时提示：这种写法在 ModernYSM 中会导致模型加载失败、游戏中无法使用。
items.en: Fixed models (such as 粉白蛔虫娘) whose animations did not move at all, e.g. “wave” in the action wheel did nothing: keyframes written as `{"vector": [...]}` now play, and importing such a model warns that ModernYSM fails to load it, so it cannot be used in game.

items.zh: 修复导入模型后底部提示横幅文字偏暗：提示横幅（以及 3D 视图里的全屏提示、操控模式键位提示）不再跟随自动取色变色，始终使用默认配色。
items.en: Fixed the dim text of the bottom notification bar after importing a model: the notification bar (and the fullscreen notice and play-mode key hints in the 3D view) no longer follows the automatic interface colors and always uses the default colors.

items.zh: 记住窗口大小和位置：关闭软件后再打开，主窗口恢复到上次窗口化时的大小和位置（最大化状态不记住，显示器拔掉后会自动移回屏幕内）。
items.en: The main window now remembers its size and position: after closing and reopening, it comes back at the last windowed size and position (the maximized state is not remembered; a window left on an unplugged monitor is moved back on screen).

items.zh: 工具栏新增“模型配置”按钮（可在设置中关闭）：侧边面板从根目录按轮盘路径查看每个设置面板的当前值，可保存、导入、导出、重置整个模型的配置，并能把每个设置面板导出为一张横版配置图，方便给别人查看。轮盘齿轮的配置界面不再带保存/导入/导出按钮。
items.en: New “Model configuration” toolbar button (can be turned off in Settings): a side panel browses the wheel from the root and shows the current values of every settings panel, saves, imports, exports or resets the whole model's configuration, and exports each settings panel as a landscape image to share. The wheel gear's settings panel no longer has the save/import/export buttons.

items.zh: 修复轮盘设置里只有一个选项的单选（如“一键重置微调参数”）点击后没有效果：现在和游戏一样，每次点击都会执行该选项。
items.en: Fixed one-option choices in wheel settings (such as “reset fine-tuning”) doing nothing when clicked: like in the game, every click now runs the option.

items.zh: 详情、设置面板、轮盘齿轮打开的配置界面，以及工具栏菜单（光照、角色状态、手持物品、贴图）、语言菜单和对话框都加入过冲效果：弹出时冲过头再回弹，关闭时先向反方向蓄力再收起。可在设置 → 外观 → “弹出窗口过冲”中关闭，并用“滑入过冲量”“滑出过冲量”两个滑条调节幅度。
items.en: The Details and Settings panels, the wheel gear's settings panel, toolbar menus (lighting, player status, held items, textures), the language menu and dialogs now overshoot: they pass their place slightly and settle back when opening, and pull back the other way before closing. Turn it off in Settings → Appearance → "Panel overshoot", and adjust the amount with the "Open overshoot" and "Close overshoot" sliders.

items.zh: 工具栏移到 3D 视图外的右下角，改为横向一排并去掉阴影，菜单从工具栏上方打开；3D 视图全屏时不显示工具栏。
items.en: The toolbar moved out of the 3D view to below its bottom-right corner, as a single row without a shadow; its menus open above it. It is not shown in the 3D view's fullscreen.

items.zh: F11 现在只进入/退出 3D 视图全屏，不再让整个软件窗口全屏；整个窗口全屏请用顶栏的全屏按钮。
items.en: F11 now enters and leaves fullscreen for the 3D view only, not the whole window; use the header's fullscreen button for the whole window.

items.zh: 删除设置“自动隐藏工具栏”：工具栏已移到 3D 视图外，不再挡住画面。
items.en: Removed the "Auto-hide toolbar" setting: the toolbar now sits outside the 3D view and no longer covers it.

items.zh: 3D 视图铺满窗口：去掉页面最大宽度并缩小四周留白，视图高度随窗口变化。
items.en: The 3D view now fills the window: no maximum page width, smaller margins, and its height follows the window.

items.zh: 设置 → 外观新增“3D 视图浮层无阴影”（默认开启）：3D 视图中的状态标签、菜单、面板、轮盘等弹出内容不再有阴影，改用更深的底色区分前景和背景。
items.en: New setting in Settings → Appearance, on by default: "Flat 3D view overlays". Status chips, menus, panels, the wheel and other pop-ups in the 3D view drop their shadows and stand out from the background with a deeper fill instead.

items.zh: 删除右上角的渲染模式切换：YSM 模型一律使用与游戏一致的原始面渲染，不再提供工程还原渲染。
items.en: Removed the render mode switch in the top-right corner: YSM models now always use raw-face rendering, which matches the game; the project-restore rendering is gone.

items.zh: 工具栏改用更深的底色；开启自动取色时显示与模型配色一致的渐变。
items.en: The toolbar has a deeper fill; with Auto color on it shows a gradient in the model's colors.

items.zh: 自动取色更贴近模型：不再把肤色计入取色（以前常被腮红、嘴唇的红色带偏成橙红），并改用模型主色调中最常见的颜色，而不是一小块最鲜艳的高光。
items.en: Auto color matches the model better: skin no longer counts (blush and lip reds used to turn many interfaces orange-red), and the seed is the most common color of the model's main hue instead of a small, very saturated highlight.

items.zh: 自动取色改用 Material 3 Expressive 的配色方案：菜单和面板饱和度更低；按钮、开关、滑条使用更浅的模型色并配深色文字。
items.en: Auto color now uses the Material 3 Expressive color scheme: menus and panels are less saturated, and buttons, switches and sliders use a lighter shade of the model color with dark text.

items.zh: 轮盘搜索定位时的扇区闪烁更明显：改为快速闪烁两下，颜色按自动取色的主色调整到与轮盘背景有足够对比度，文字同时切换为黑或白以保持清晰。
items.en: The sector flash when Wheel Search jumps to a result is now much easier to see: two quick blinks in the theme's primary colour, adjusted for enough contrast with the wheel, with the label switching to black or white so it stays readable.

items.zh: 新增轮盘搜索：在设置的“搜索”中打开后弹出一个独立窗口，按名称搜索轮盘里的动作、子分类和设置面板，并显示所在的轮盘路径和页码；点击结果会自动打开轮盘、翻到那一页并闪烁对应分区。窗口可调节透明度。
items.en: New Wheel Search: turn it on under Settings → Search to open a separate window that finds actions, sub-categories and settings panels in the action wheel by name, showing each one's wheel path and page. Clicking a result opens the wheel on that page and flashes the sector. The window's opacity is adjustable.

items.zh: 详情、预览、设置收进左侧“查看器”下面；打开软件直接显示预览，详情和设置改为居中弹出的面板（左上返回、右上关闭），打开时模型的动画和声音不再停止。
items.en: Details, Preview and Settings now sit under Viewer in the left rail; the app opens straight to the preview, and Details and Settings open as a centered panel (back at top left, close at top right) without stopping the model's animation or sound.

items.zh: 截图按钮移到右侧工具栏，去掉 3D 视图右下角挡住画面的截图面板和骨骼数显示。
items.en: The screenshot button moved into the right-hand toolbar; the panel in the bottom-right corner of the 3D view that covered the model, along with its bone count, is gone.
